title: Enantioselective Recognition and Separation of C2 Symmetric Substances via Chiral Metal–Organic Frameworks

material_class.structural_family: chiral Ru–Eu metal–organic framework with dinuclear Eu secondary building units

synthesis.procedure: Eu(NO3)3·6H2O, Δ-RuL and 2-fluorobenzoic acid were mixed in DMF, sealed in a screw-capped 10 mL vial and heated at 115 °C for 3 days. After cooling to room temperature, the red octahedral crystals were washed several times with DMF and acetonitrile and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature; red octahedral crystals washed with DMF and acetonitrile and dried under vacuum.

properties.summary: Its circular dichroism spectrum is the mirror image of that of Λ-RuEu-MOF. BINOL enantiomers cause distinguishable CD wavelength shifts, enabling optical enantiodifferentiation.

measurements.name: CD wavelength shift upon S-BINOL addition
CD wavelength shift upon R-BINOL addition

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The enantiomeric counterpart of Λ-RuEu-MOF is a three-dimensional porous framework assembled from propeller-like chiral Ru metalloligands and six-connected dinuclear Eu secondary building units. The article describes the two single-crystal structures as mirror images.

material_class.structural_family: chiral Ru–Eu metal–organic framework with dinuclear Eu secondary building units

synthesis.procedure: Prepared under the same conditions as Δ-RuEu-MOF, replacing Δ-RuL with Λ-RuL: Eu(NO3)3·6H2O, Λ-RuL and 2-fluorobenzoic acid in DMF were sealed in a screw-capped 10 mL vial and heated at 115 °C for 3 days. The mixture was cooled to room temperature; the crystals were washed with DMF and acetonitrile and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature; crystals washed with DMF and acetonitrile and dried under vacuum.

properties.summary: The framework displays circular dichroism and optically differentiates R- and S-BINOL through distinct host–guest CD shifts. Its CD spectrum mirrors that of Δ-RuEu-MOF.

measurements.name: CD peak upon R-BINOL addition
measurements.conditions: Host–guest CD experiment; shift from 296.0 nm

measurements.name: CD peak upon S-BINOL addition
measurements.conditions: Host–guest CD experiment; shift from 296.0 nm

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Single-crystal XRD places Λ-RuEu-MOF in the chiral orthorhombic space group I222. Propeller-like Ru metalloligands coordinate six-connected [Eu2(μ2-H2O)(H2O)3(-COO−)6] secondary building units to form a three-dimensional porous framework with one-dimensional channels described as approximately 16 × 31 Å.
